say:1:1033136001:1.text: Same old problem. My knee's in agony. I can't stand up, let alone walk.
say:1:1033136001:1.source_cn: 老毛病了，就是膝盖疼得厉害，站不起来，也走不动道。
say:1:1033136001:1.male: Same old problem. My knee's in agony. I can't stand up, let alone walk.
say:1:1033136001:1.female: Same old problem. My knee's in agony. I can't stand up, let alone walk.

say:2:1033136002:1.text: My leg always gets like this in humid places. Let it be.
say:2:1033136002:1.source_cn: 我到这潮湿的地方，腿就容易这样，不打紧的。
say:2:1033136002:1.male: My leg always gets like this in humid places. Let it be.
say:2:1033136002:1.female: My leg always gets like this in humid places. Let it be.

say:3:1033136003:1.text: I always heard that this Dark Forest was a nice place. Never thought it'd be so gloomy and cold.
say:3:1033136003:1.source_cn: 这薄暮丛林，听上去像是个好地方，谁能想到这么阴冷呢。
say:3:1033136003:1.male: I always heard that this Dark Forest was a nice place. Never thought it'd be so gloomy and cold.
say:3:1033136003:1.female: I always heard that this Dark Forest was a nice place. Never thought it'd be so gloomy and cold.

say:4:1033136004:1.text: Ah, if only I had a nice, warm blanket...
say:4:1033136004:1.source_cn: 唉，要是有床暖和的被子就好咯……
say:4:1033136004:1.male: Ah, if only I had a nice, warm blanket...
say:4:1033136004:1.female: Ah, if only I had a nice, warm blanket...
